what: tường lan can bãi tắm: one span of the low wall of rough granite blocks between the walk and the beach of Bãi Trước (a half post at each end, an opening under the rail)
uses: Plan 0026, R4: the low wall along the walk of the park and the walk of the sea (walls and beach_wall of data/showcase/bai_truoc.json): the game puts the pieces one after another along the line, the port end of a piece on the port start of the next (two half posts make a whole post), the origin on the line of the wall at the walk, +y to the sand. At an opening to the sand (R10) the game leaves out the pieces.

sources.author: Đỗ Tuấn Hùng / VnExpress
sources.shows: Two women who sell food by the low wall of the beach (a crop): rough grey granite blocks in courses, a square post at the end of a section, a top rail, openings between the posts, a woman in a nón lá who stands beside the wall, a bicycle against it, the boats of the bay through the openings.

sources.author: Marcus Nguyen (Flickr)
sources.shows: Sunset at Bãi Trước from the walk: frangipani trees in silhouette, the paved walk, and the low wall across the view: a rail on posts with the sea in the openings, each opening about 0.65 of the distance from one post to the next.

sources.author: Marcus Nguyen (Flickr)
sources.shows: The sea and ships through one opening of the low wall: rough grey granite blocks about 0.3 m long with dark joints, the rail over the opening, the opening about 3.4 times as wide as it is high.

sources.author: Lam Tr Th
sources.shows: The low wall of the beach along the walk of the park, to the south: rough granite blocks, square posts, a flat top rail that is lighter, low openings between the posts, the walk of tiles, leaning palms, the beach and Núi Nhỏ.

sources.author: Ted McGrath (time-to-look, Flickr)
sources.shows: Painted fishing boats on the sand of Bãi Trước at low tide; behind them the low wall on its wall of blocks, in sections, with a long flight of steps down to the sand, palms and light blue lamp poles.

sources.author: Nguyen tan dat Dat (Flickr)
sources.shows: Report 0026, Q26: the low wall at the eye of S1. The GPS of the camera file is 10.345615 N, 107.073647 E, about 15 m from the place of the photo of S1 (10.345688 N, 107.073777 E). The camera stands on the sand and looks to the north, to Núi Lớn. At the right, the wall goes north from a few meters from the camera: 4 or 5 courses of light grey granite blocks on a concrete base (the sand under it is washed out), then square posts of blocks with low dark openings between them, under a flat light cap. A man on the sand is as high as the cap. Further north: concrete steps down to the sand, a short part of the same wall, and more steps.

sources.author: Nguyễn Văn Tăng (tvgsxd, Flickr)
sources.shows: Report 0026, Q26: the low wall near the north end of the beach (a pin on the map at 10.346111 N, 107.073333 E, about 65 m north-west of the eye of S1, put by hand). The camera stands at the water and looks to the south. At the top left, the nearest part of the wall from the side: light grey granite blocks in courses on a concrete base, square posts of blocks, wide low openings between them (about 0.4 m high and 1.5 m to 2 m wide), and a flat light grey cap; it ends at a corner post, and a gap goes into the park, where sellers sit under umbrellas.

length.source: One span, from the middle of a post to the middle of the next. Photo 1 (2018, the wall across the view): each opening is 0.65 of the distance from one post to the next (48 of 70 px, 42 of 65 px, 37 of 60 px); with openings of 0.9 m: 1.35 m.

opening.source: Photo 0 (2020): an opening is 130 px wide where the wall is 147 px for 1 m: 0.88 m. Photo 2 (2018): an opening is 3.4 times as wide as it is high (0.28 m): 0.95 m.

post.source: The span less the opening: 0.45 m, as in photo 0 (a post is about one block and a half).

height.source: Photo 0: the woman in a nón lá (1.55 m, 1.67 m with her hat: 225 px) stands a little farther than the wall; at the wall (its foot 170 px under the horizon, her feet 155 px) the scale is 147 px for 1 m, and the wall is 154 px from the walk to the top of the rail: 1.05 m; 1.0 m to 1.05 m.

cap.source: Photo 0: the rail is 15 px of the 154 px of the wall: 0.1 m.

opening_height.source: Photo 0: the openings are 44 px high: 0.29 m (the height less the rail and the wall under the openings: 0.28 m).

base.source: Photo 0: the wall under the openings is 95 px: 0.62 m.

width.source: Photos 2 (2018) and 3 (2014): the rail stands out a little over the face of the blocks: 0.42 m under a rail of 0.46 m (the spec: 0.4 m and 0.45 m).

cap_width.source: Photo 3 (2014): the rail is as wide as the posts and stands out a little; photo 2 (2018) the same. estimate (no source) of 0.02 m on each side.

course.source: Photo 0: the courses are 30 px to 35 px high: 0.2 m to 0.24 m (three courses under the openings).

block.source: Photo 0: the blocks are about 45 px long: 0.3 m; photo 2: an opening is 2.8 blocks wide.

colors.value: blocks #9a958b, rail #aba69c, joints #66625b, a darker band at the foot
colors.source: Photo 0 (2020): rough grey granite with dark joints; photo 3 (2014): the median of a block in the sun is #9a958b and the top of the rail is lighter, worn by people who sit on it.

looks.seen: Next to photos 0 to 4: the base, the half posts at the ends, the opening of 0.9 m by 0.28 m and the rail that stands out a little are as in photos 0 and 2; two pieces in a row make a post of 0.45 m, as in photo 1. The grey of the blocks in the sun (#9a958b of photo 3) is right; the joints of the blocks are at the near level only, so the mid level is one rough grey.
The mid level of the last blueprint: the same as the look before (the joints are at the near level only, and now no joint is on an end face).
The mid level of the last blueprint: the same as the look before.

Next to photos 0, 2 and 3: courses of rough grey blocks of 0.3 m by 0.2 m with joints a half block apart from one course to the next, the opening under the rail, the lighter rail. In photo 2 the joints are deep and dark, here they are painted lines; the posts have no joints over the sill.

Report 0026, Q25: the files of the lock of World e8754d6 (build/look/tuong_bai_tam_far.png). The same span and opening, one grey.
